1.outline: Term theme: 'Camera & Video'. Plan a 60-second video shot by shot on a storyboard before filming anything.
objectives: Plan a video in a sequence of shots.
Sketch each shot on a storyboard.
Estimate roughly how long each shot will be.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Watch and break down
plan.detail: Watch a short example video and count how many shots it uses.

plan.title: Storyboard
plan.detail: Sketch 5-6 shots for a 60-second video on a chosen topic (school tour or safety message).

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Pitch the storyboard to a partner in 30 seconds. Log out.

successCriteria: My storyboard has 5-6 planned shots.
Each shot has a rough time estimate.
I can pitch my video plan to a partner.

2.outline: Learn three filming rules: hold the camera steady, film with good light on the subject, and record in a quiet space for clear sound.
objectives: Hold a camera steady while filming.
Film with the light on the subject, not behind it.
Choose a quiet space for clear sound.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Three filming rules
plan.detail: Steady, lit, quiet — demonstrate a bad and a good example of each.

plan.title: Practice shots
plan.detail: In pairs, film two of the storyboard's shots following the three rules.

plan.title: Review
plan.detail: Watch back and check: steady, lit, clear sound? Devices counted in.

successCriteria: I filmed a shot that stayed steady.
My subject was well lit.
My audio was clear, without background noise.

3.subtopic: Bring Clips In and Trim Them
3.outline: Import filmed clips into Clipchamp or CapCut and trim off the unwanted start and end of each clip.
3.sowResources: Clipchamp / CapCut, class shared drive for clips.
objectives: Import video clips into an editor.
Trim the start and end of a clip.
Arrange clips in storyboard order.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Import clips
plan.detail: Import the filmed clips into the editor's timeline.

plan.title: Trim and order
plan.detail: Trim each clip and drag them into the storyboard's shot order.

plan.title: Playback check
plan.detail: Play the trimmed sequence through and check the order makes sense. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My clips are imported into the editor.
Each clip is trimmed to remove unwanted footage.
My clips are in the storyboard's order.

4.outline: Add a title at the start of the video and captions on key shots to help the audience follow along.
objectives: Add a title text to the start of the video.
Add a caption to at least one shot.
Choose readable text size and colour.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add a title
plan.detail: Add a title card at the start with the video's name.

plan.title: Add captions
plan.detail: Add one or two captions to key shots, checking they are readable against the background.

plan.title: Check readability
plan.detail: Partner checks all text is readable. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My video has a title at the start.
At least one shot has a readable caption.
My text colour is readable against its background.

5.outline: Add background music at a sensible volume and a simple transition between two shots.
objectives: Add background music to the video.
Set the music volume so it doesn't drown the voice.
Add one simple transition between shots.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add music
plan.detail: Add a royalty-free music track and adjust the volume so any speech stays clear.

plan.title: Add a transition
plan.detail: Add one simple transition between two shots — not one on every cut.

plan.title: Full playback
plan.detail: Play the whole video and check music, captions and transitions all work together. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My video has background music at a sensible volume.
My video has one simple transition.
My video plays through smoothly.

6.outline: Export the finished video and discuss sharing and consent: who is allowed to be filmed, and who the video can be shown to.
objectives: Export a finished video file.
Explain why consent matters before filming someone.
Explain who the video is appropriate to share with.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Export the video
plan.detail: Export the finished edit to a file, checking it plays back correctly.

plan.title: Consent discussion
plan.detail: Discuss: why should you ask before filming someone? What if they say no?

plan.title: Who can see it?
plan.detail: Discuss appropriate sharing: class only, school only, or public — and why that matters. Log out.

successCriteria: I exported my video successfully.
I can explain why consent matters before filming someone.
I can explain who is appropriate to share the video with.

7.outline: Finish producing the chosen video — a school tour or an online-safety PSA — pulling together filming, editing, titles and music.
objectives: Finish filming any remaining shots.
Complete the full edit with titles, captions and music.
Meet the storyboard's brief.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Fill gaps
plan.detail: Film any remaining shots from the storyboard.

plan.title: Complete the edit
plan.detail: Finish editing: all shots trimmed, title, captions, music, one transition.

plan.title: Brief check
plan.detail: Check the video matches the original storyboard brief. Save and log out.

successCriteria: All planned shots are filmed.
My edit includes title, captions and music.
My video matches the storyboard brief.

8.outline: Screen the finished videos to the class and give each other kind, specific feedback.
objectives: Watch classmates' finished videos.
Give kind, specific feedback on one video.
Reflect on what worked well in my own video.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Premiere screening
plan.detail: Screen the videos to the class on the projector, one after another.

plan.title: Feedback slips
plan.detail: Write one piece of kind, specific feedback on a feedback slip for a classmate's video.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: Save the finished video to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I watched and responded to classmates' videos.
I gave one kind, specific piece of feedback.
My finished video is saved to the portfolio folder.

9.outline: Return to the video and apply one piece of feedback received during the premiere, then re-export.
objectives: Choose one useful piece of feedback to act on.
Apply the change to the video.
Re-export the improved version.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Apply feedback
plan.detail: Choose one feedback slip and make the suggested change to the video.

plan.title: Re-export
plan.detail: Export the improved version and check it plays correctly.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: I chose one useful piece of feedback.
I applied the change to my video.
My improved video is re-exported and saved.

10.outline: Rehearse the term's video skills in pairs: film a short shot, trim it, add a title, export.
10.sowResources: Recap slide deck, practice task cards.
objectives: Recall the term's video production process in order.
Rehearse filming, trimming and exporting with a partner.
Identify the trickiest step.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Process recap
plan.detail: Recap: storyboard, film, trim, title, music, export — as a class chant.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Film and edit one short shot with a partner reading the task card, then swap.

plan.title: Tricky step check
plan.detail: Name the step you still find hardest. Log out.

successCriteria: I can list the term's video production steps in order.
I rehearsed filming and editing with a partner.
I know which step needs more practice.

11.outline: Individual task: film and edit a short video meeting a given brief, using at least one trim, one title/caption and appropriate export.
objectives: Film and edit a short video to a given brief.
Trim clips and add a title.
Export the finished video correctly.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task and rubric.

plan.title: Film and edit
plan.detail: Individual practical: film 2-3 short shots to the brief, trim and add a title.

plan.title: Export and save
plan.detail: Export the finished video and save with the correct name.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Celebrate the term's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: I filmed and edited a short video to the brief.
My video is trimmed and has a title.
My video is exported and saved correctly.
